newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 4.

text.p: CHINA TIMES - United States launches cruise missile strike on Iraq.
Taiwan stocks plunge, gold price rises as tensions in Middle East mount.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - United States fires 27 cruise missiles against air defense targets in Iraq.
International oil price, U.S. dollar rise over mounting tensions in Iraq.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - U.S. launches missile attack on Iraq, buffeting financial markets worldwide.
South Africa says it is prepared to establish ties with communist China.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan's Chinese Petroleum Corp says it has 97 days worth of oil reserves and will not raise domestic oil price in near term.
Mainland Affairs Council to freeze economic liberalisation policies toward mainland China.
